parameters.help_en: The tenant ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198073.html operation to obtain the value of this parameter
parameters.help_zh: 租户ID，可通过调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198073.html获取该参数的值
parameters.name: tid

parameters.help_en: The workflow instance ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/144642.html operation to obtain the value of this parameter
parameters.help_zh: 审批流ID，可通过调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/144642.html 获取该参数的值
parameters.name: workflow_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The approval action. Valid values:
AGREE: agree
CANCEL: cancel
REJECT: reject
TRANSFER: transfer
ADD_APPROVAL_NODE: add an approval node
parameters.help_zh:
审批动作，取值及说明如下：
AGREE：同意。
CANCEL：取消。
REJECT：拒绝。
TRANSFER：转交。
ADD_APPROVAL_NODE：加签
parameters.name: approval_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the user to whom the ticket is transferred. This parameter is required when the ApprovalType parameter is set to TRANSFER
parameters.help_zh: 被转交用户的ID。ApprovalType参数为TRANSFER时必填
parameters.name: new_approver

parameters.help_en: The ID of the user who transfers the ticket. Default value: the ID of the current user. If the current user is an administrator or a database administrator (DBA), you can specify the ID of another relevant user
parameters.help_zh: 转交用户的ID，默认为当前操作用户的ID。当用户为管理员或DBA时，可指定其他相关人员的ID
parameters.name: old_approver

parameters.help_en: The ID of the approval node to be added. The node must be a custom approval node. This parameter is required when the ApprovalType parameter is set to ADD_APPROVAL_NODE
parameters.help_zh:
ApprovalType为ADD_APPROVAL_NODE时必填。
添加的审批节点ID，该节点必须为用户自定义审批节点
parameters.name: approval_node_id

parameters.help_en:
The position where the approval node is added. This parameter is required when the ApprovalType parameter is set to ADD_APPROVAL_NODE. Valid values:

PRE_ADD_APPROVAL_NODE: add the approval node before the current node
POST_ADD_APPROVAL_NODE: add the approval node after the current node
parameters.help_zh:
ApprovalType为ADD_APPROVAL_NODE时必填。
加签的位置，取值及说明如下：

PRE_ADD_APPROVAL_NODE：前加签。
POST_ADD_APPROVAL_NODE：后加签
parameters.name: approval_node_pos

parameters.help_en:
Specify this parameter or the NewApprover parameter when the ApprovalType parameter is set to TRANSFER.

The list of IDs of the users to whom the ticket is transferred. Separate multiple user IDs with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh:
ApprovalType为TRANSFER（转交）时填写。NewApprover参数与本参数二选一填写即可。

被转交用户的ID列表，用户ID之间使用英文逗号分隔
parameters.name: new_approver_list

parameters.help_en: The Alibaba Cloud account UID of the user who actually calls the API operation. <props="china">For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2835451.html.</props>
parameters.help_zh: 实际调用API的用户的阿里云账号UID。<props="china">更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2835451.html。</props>
parameters.name: real_login_user_uid

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request is successful. Valid values:
true: The request is successful.
false: The request fails
Success.description_zh:
请求是否成功，返回值如下：
true：请求成功
false：请求失败
